sources.summary: interihotel is the meeting point for hospitality design. A leading event where interior design, architecture, products, technology and business come together to explore the future of hotels, restaurants and hospitality spaces. Discover the latest trends in furniture, lighting, materials, textiles and contract solutions, explore innovative projects and concepts, and connect with architects, interior designers, brands, manufacturers, hoteliers and other professionals from across the industry. The scale of the event reflects the strength of the sector: the latest edition, interihotel BCN25, brought together 11,675 professionals from 53 countries and 291 exhibiting brands, while identifying more than 2,500 active hospitality projects.
